sloka: गवाम् शत सहस्रेण शुनःशेपम् नरेश्वरः ।गृहीत्वा परम प्रीतो जगाम रघुनंदन ॥१-६१-२३॥
transliteration: gavām śata sahasreṇa śunaḥśepam nareśvaraḥ ।gṛhītvā parama prīto jagāma raghunaṁdana ॥1-61-23॥

translations.english: Then the royal sage Ambarisha, of great splendour and great renown, set Shunahshepa in his chariot in haste and went swiftly on his way.
